title: Elemental TD
subtitle: Tower Defense
start_early: Start now. The wave starts automatically when the countdown ends.
inspect: Tap a tower or an open tile.
spirit_help: One spirit takes the field in each bonus round. You earn its tier and gold either way. If it reaches the gate, it deals 5 damage to the barrier or gate.
help: Build, upgrade, infuse, and sell during an assault or between waves. Tap a tower or enemy to inspect it. Regular waves begin after 30 seconds or when you tap Start Wave. A solo spirit trial runs before waves 5, 10, 15, and so on. Level 2+ elemental towers with distinct elements can fuse.
hints: Choose a tower and tap an open tile to build.
Start the wave when your defenses are ready.
Tap a tower to inspect or upgrade it during combat.
Choose a spirit for a solo bonus round.
Stop the spirit before it takes 5 gate lives.
Infuse a level 2 Arrow or Cannon after earning an element.
Fuse two level 2+ elemental towers of different elements. Add a level 2+ third element to any dual.
If a Warlock stuns a tower, tap it to Rally.
new_info: Starting over replaces the current Survival checkpoint.
base_stats: Green + values show active support bonuses. Range is in tiles.
fusion_at_most_three: Choose a dual tower and one new element
fusion_partner_help: Choose a level %d+ elemental tower or a dual with different elements.
trial_intro: Choose one spirit to earn its tier and gold. Defeat it to prevent 5 damage to the gate.
infusion_explainer: Any unlocked element can infuse a level 2+ tower. The applied tier depends on the tower level and the tier you unlocked.
fusion_tip: Tap a highlighted tower to preview fusion.
invalid_site: Choose an open tile beside the road
legend_no_matches: No recipes use only these elements.
legend_filter_tip: Show towers made from the selected elements

burn: Deals damage over time. Additional stacks can make it stronger.
poison: Deals damage over time. The number of stacks depends on the attack.
slow: Reduces movement speed. Bosses take half-strength slows.
freeze: Stops an ordinary enemy in ice until the effect expires.
root: Holds an ordinary enemy in place while towers can keep attacking.
slip: An ordinary enemy slides on ice, then stumbles and lets the group catch up.
disease: Deals damage based on the last %d seconds of other damage. Spreads when the enemy is defeated.
curse: Increases damage the affected enemy takes.
shred: Temporarily lowers armor so attacks deal more damage.
silence: Suppresses special enemy traits, including immune shields and revival.
heal_block: Prevents the enemy from recovering health or reviving.
phasing: Blocks damage for %d seconds every %d seconds. Null can dispel it.
